title: ALS-associated A315E and A315pT variants exhibit distinct mechanisms in inducing irreversible aggregation of TDP-43(312-317) peptides.
authors: Liu, Xianshi; Lao, Zenghui; Li, Xuhua; Dong, Xuewei; Wei, Guanghong
one_liner_zh: 该文用全原子MD模拟研究ALS相关TDP-43肽段A315E/A315pT变体的不可逆聚集机制，虽涉及蛋白-DNA结合蛋白TDP-43，但核心是蛋白自身聚集而非蛋白-DNA互作，且无AI或对接建模，仅属边缘相关。
abstract: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) is intensively associated with insoluble aggregates formed by transactivation response element DNA-binding protein 43 (TDP-43) in the cytoplasm of neuron cells. A recent experimental study reported that two ALS-linked familial variants, A315E and A315pT (pT, phosphorylated threonine), can induce irreversible aggregation of the TDP-43 (312)NFGAFS(317) segment (TDP-43(312-317)). However, the underlying molecular mechanism remains largely elusive. Here, we investigated the early aggregation process of the wild type (WT) (312)NFGAFS(317) segment and its A315E and A315pT variants by performing multiple microsecond all-atom molecular dynamics simulations. Our simulations show that the two variants display lower fluidity than WT, consistent with their decreased labilities observed in previous denaturation assay experiments. Despite each of the two variants carrying one negative charge, unexpectedly, we find that both A315E mutation and A315pT phosphorylation enhance intermolecular interactions and result in the formation of more compact oligomers. Compared to WT, A315E oligomers possess low beta-sheet content but a compact hydrophobic core, while A315pT oligomers have high beta-sheet content and large beta-sheets. Side chain hydrogen-bonding and hydrophobic interactions as well as N312-E315 salt bridges contribute most to the increased aggregation propensity of the A315E mutant. By contrast, main chain and side chain hydrogen-bonding interactions, side chain hydrophobic and aromatic interactions, are crucial to the enhanced aggregation capability of the A315pT variant. These results indicate that glutamate mutation and phosphorylation at position 315 induce the irreversible aggregation of TDP-43(312-317) peptides through differential mechanisms, which remind us that we should be careful in the investigation of the phosphorylation effect on protein aggregation by using phosphomimetic substitutions. This study provides mechanistic insights into the A315E/A315pT-induced irreversible aggregation of TDP-43(312-317), which may be helpful for the in-depth understanding of ALS-mutation/phosphorylation-associated liquid-to-solid phase transition of TDP-43 protein aggregates.
abstract_zh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化症（amyotrophic lateral sclerosis, ALS）与神经元细胞质中由反式激活反应元件DNA结合蛋白43（TDP-43）形成的不溶性聚集体密切相关。近期一项实验研究报告称，两种与家族性ALS相关的变异体A315E和A315pT（pT，磷酸化苏氨酸）可诱导TDP-43(312)NFGAFS(317)片段（TDP-43(312-317)）发生不可逆聚集。然而，其潜在的分子机制在很大程度上仍不清楚。在此，我们通过进行多次微秒级全原子分子动力学模拟，研究了野生型（WT）(312)NFGAFS(317)片段及其A315E和A315pT变异体的早期聚集过程。我们的模拟显示，这两种变异体比WT具有更低的流动性，这与先前变性测定实验中观察到的其降低的不稳定性一致。尽管这两种变异体各携带一个负电荷，但出乎意料的是，我们发现A315E突变和A315pT磷酸化均增强了分子间相互作用，并导致形成更紧凑的低聚体。与WT相比，A315E低聚体具有较低的β-折叠含量但拥有紧凑的疏水核心，而A315pT低聚体则具有较高的β-折叠含量和较大的β-折叠片。侧链氢键和疏水相互作用以及N312-E315盐桥对A315E突变体聚集倾向的增加贡献最大。相比之下，主链和侧链氢键相互作用、侧链疏水和芳香相互作用对A315pT变异体增强的聚集能力至关重要。这些结果表明，第315位的谷氨酸突变和磷酸化通过不同的机制诱导TDP-43(312-317)肽段的不可逆聚集，这提醒我们在使用磷酸化模拟替代研究磷酸化对蛋白质聚集的影响时应谨慎。本研究为A315E/A315pT诱导的TDP-43(312-317)不可逆聚集提供了机制性见解，这可能有助于深入理解与ALS突变/磷酸化相关的TDP-43蛋白聚集体的液-固相转变。
